support_scope: Classification-aware preflight validation helpers and compatibility matrix for AR-DRG, AECC, UDG, Tier 2, and AMHCC, including strict required-field checks, pricing-year/version compatibility checks, licensed-input caveats, exports through nwau_py, and targeted validator tests.

gap_register.gap: Not every calculator and CLI entry point is documented as enforcing the shared preflight validator end-to-end.
gap_register.rationale: The shared validator is implemented and tested, while broader endpoint-by-endpoint enforcement remains a downstream calculator/API surface obligation.

gap_register.gap: Licensed AR-DRG, ICD-10-AM, ACHI, and ACS products are not redistributed or reimplemented.
gap_register.rationale: The validator records version compatibility and licensed-input caveats only; proprietary grouping assets remain external.

description: Add classification-aware input validation and version matrices for AR-DRG, AECC, UDG, Tier 2, and AMHCC.
